name: Goddric, Cloaked Reveler
oracle_text:
Haste
Celebration — As long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, Goddric is a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and "{R}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn." (It loses all other creature types.)
blocked_sentences: Celebration — As long as two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn, Goddric is a Dragon with base power and toughness 4/4, flying, and "{R}: Dragons you control get +1/+0 until end of turn." (It loses all other creature types.)

needs.what: a static effect (layer 4) that REPLACES a permanent's creature types with a printed list while it applies -- "is a Dragon ... (It loses all other creature types.)" -- e.g. `subtypes` on the `set_types` static, or a `set_subtypes` static, read in `characteristics` so that, under its `condition`, the permanent's creature subtypes become exactly ["Dragon"] (Human and Noble removed) while its card types and supertypes are untouched. The same shape covers every 'is a <type> ... loses all other creature types' static (Celebration cards, Ixalan-style flip-free shapeshifts).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `set_types` replaces only card types and keeps every subtype whose class is still present (characteristics.py layer 0: `subtypes = {sub for sub in subtypes if SUBTYPE_CLASS.get(sub, 'Creature') in types}`), so `set_types: ["Creature"]` leaves Human Noble in place; `add_subtype` only unions Dragon on top, giving a Human Noble Dragon that a Human or Noble lord would still pump and a Human/Noble filter would still match; the `animate` op's `exact` flag does replace creature types but is a one-shot op with a duration, not a static that switches on and off with the Celebration condition. The rest of the sentence is expressible: the condition is a static `cmp` >= 2 over `{"permanents_entered_this_turn": {"controller": "you", "not_types": ["Land"]}}`, base 4/4 is a `set_pt` static, flying a `grant_keyword` static, and the quoted ability a `grant_ability` static over `grantable_abilities` holding an activated `{R}` pump of Dragons you control -- so only the type replacement is missing, and no partial answer was written.
